ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Potential Check Fraud in New Accounts

Check deposit activities in new accounts with small balance are potential red flags for check fraud and might require preemptive investigation. The scenario looks for the check deposit(s) in the current day which is within a few days after the account opened date. Account was open with a cash deposit followed by a withdrawal on the same day or a few days after using a particular transaction channel such as ATM, leaving a small balance amount in the account.

Acct_Bal as ( select AB.NET_WRTH_AM as Net_Worth_Amt, AB.ACCT_INTRL_ID as Acct_Intrl_Id from @BUSINESS@.ACCT_BAL_POSN_SMRY AB where (AB.DATA_DUMP_DT,AB.ACCT_INTRL_ID) in ( select max(AB.DATA_DUMP_DT) AB.DATA_DUMP_DT < (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) group by T1.Acct_Intrl_Id ) )
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ----Main Query--- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ select V.ACCT_INTRL_ID, V.ACCT_SEQ_ID, V.TOT_CHK_DEP_AMT, (CASE WHEN V.TOT_CHK_DEP_AMT - TRUNC(V.TOT_CHK_DEP_AMT, -@LRF_Digits) = 0 THEN V.TOT_CHK_DEP_AMT ELSE 0 END) LRF_AM, V.PRIOR_DAY_NET_WORTH, V.ACCT_AGE, V.OVERALL_RISK, V.EFFECTV_RISK_LVL, V.ACTVTY_RISK_LVL, V.CURR_DAY from ( select T.Acct_Intrl_Id, T.Acct_Seq_Id , ---calculating "Tot Chk Dep Amt"--- sum(T.Trxn_Base_Amt) as Tot_Chk_Dep_Amt, ---calculating "Prior Day Net Worth"--- max(T.Net_Worth_Amt) as Prior_Day_Net_Worth, ---calculating "Acct Age "--- max(K.CLNDR_DT - T.Acct_Open_Dt) as Acct_Age , ---calculating "Overall Risk"--- case when max(T.Effective_Risk)>= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(T.Activity_Risk) >= @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' when max(T.Effective_Risk)< @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl and max(T.Activity_Risk) < @Actvty_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'RR' else 'MR' end OVERALL_RISK, ---calculating "Effectv Risk Lvl"--- max(T.Effective_Risk) as Effectv_Risk_Lvl, ---calculating "Actvty Risk Lvl"--- max(T.Activity_Risk) as Actvty_Risk_Lvl , max(K.CLNDR_DT) as CURR_DAY from ( select A.Acct_Intrl_Id as Acct_Intrl_Id, A.Acct_Seq_Id as Acct_Seq_Id, A.Acct_Open_Dt as Acct_Open_Dt, A.Data_Dump_Dt as Data_Dump_Dt, A.Check_Dep_Amt as Trxn_Base_Amt, AB.Net_Worth_Amt as Net_Worth_Amt, A.Effective_Risk as Effective_Risk, AR.Activity_Risk as Activity_Risk from aocd_wlp A inner join Max_Acty_Risk AR on A.Acct_Intrl_Id=AR.Account_Id inner join Acct_Bal Ab on A.Acct_Intrl_Id=AB.Acct_Intrl_Id )T, (select * from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) K group by T.Acct_Intrl_Id, T.Acct_Seq_Id having -----"Frequency Period "--- max(T.Data_Dump_Dt) = (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) )V where exists ( -----Condition : to find that there should be atleast one withdrawal----- select 1 from Activity_Risk AR where V.ACCT_INTRL_ID=AR.Account_Id ---Parameter : "HR Max Days Acct Open", "MR Max Days Acct Open", "RR Max Days Acct Open"--- and AR.Trxn_Exec_Dt <= ADD_DAYS(AR.Acct_Open_Dt,case when V.Overall_Risk = 'HR' then @HR_Max_Days_Acct_Open when V.Overall_Risk = 'MR' then @MR_Max_Days_Acct_Open when V.Overall_Risk = 'RR' then @RR_Max_Days_Acct_Open end) and AR.Trxn_Exec_Dt >= AR.Acct_Open_Dt )
